decision.justification: Selected 'weighted on pool4 weighted by w4' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.677. Series context: trend strength 0.6203 and seasonal strength 0.7061; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.072); 12 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 4.987.
